title: Processes
description: Reusable procedures: API calls, loops, decisions, approvals, checks and browser steps. Every save creates a new version.

import.hint: Paste a definition or load one file to review it first. Selecting several files imports each of them directly (e.g. the files in the repository's examples/processes folder).
